description: As viewer with the server's ShowPlayerButtons off: the player's button row has none of Bookmarks' three buttons while jellyfin-web's own are there, and Shift+B still bookmarks the moment (the toast with Name it). Run by bookmarks-player-probe.mjs, which turns the setting off before and back on afterwards and deletes the bookmark; on its own it needs ShowPlayerButtons off.

steps.name: find Chaptered Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: details page with a Play button
video page, video playing, jellyfin-web's own buttons there
none of ours, jellyfin-web's untouched, the capabilities were read
the shortcut still bookmarks: one more, with the toast
two Shift+B presses in one go, the second before the first answers, AskForName off
steps.script: const toasts = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].filter(t => /^Bookmarked at /.test(t.textContent)).length; const before = toasts(); const press = () => document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'B', code: 'KeyB', shiftKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const first = press(); const second = press(); return { toastsBefore: before, firstTaken: !first, secondTaken: !second };

steps.name: both presses were the binding's (prevented); the guard ignored the second
one bookmark more and one toast more, not two of each
steps.script: const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); return { bookmarks: list.length - Number(__vars.before), toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].filter(t => /^Bookmarked at /.test(t.textContent)).length - __vars.double.toastsBefore };

steps.name: two bookmarks of this check (the shortcut's and the double's first) and one toast from the double
delete the bookmarks this check made
steps.script: const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const mine = list.slice(Number(__vars.before)); for (const b of mine) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); } return mine.length;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag and jellyfin-web's player teardown excepted)
